## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related issue

Link the issue or discussion, or explain why none is needed.

## Validation

List the checks and manual tests you ran.

## Privacy, security, and compatibility

Describe any effect on browser permissions, GitHub scopes, network access,
credential handling, archive formats, deletion behavior, or existing users.
Write `None` when there is no effect.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include private archive content,
      secrets, personal data, or unrelated files.
- [ ] I used synthetic or redistributable fixtures and screenshots.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavioral changes.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, or I documented why a check could not run.
- [ ] User-facing English and German documentation stay consistent.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by:` trailer (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] My contribution is licensed under the project's MIT License.
